scope: Capture and temporarily audition a paused PSF Noise-only voice using the existing Synth Noise mode.

requires: selected NON flag and mask agreement
behavior.noisePitch: All MIDI keys trigger the envelope at fixed support-sample PITCH4096. Noise Clock changes noise character; Reference key is disabled and ignored for Noise captures.
behavior.preserved: Editor shared reverb; original PSF CPU/RAM and frozen Live position; editor checkpoint during temporary audition.
behavior.portablePreset: Existing instrument v1 with Noise enabled and Morph/PMON disabled; save/reimport retains Clock, ADSR, voice settings and support loop.
behavior.unsupported: PMON carriers, including Noise with PMON. Same-frame full RAM payload remains required by the existing transport contract.

temporaryClient.visibility: Private borrowed-client method; no public npm/type API changed.
temporaryClient.binding: Bind the exact immutable looping sample object to the current Code lease, separate from reusable numeric IDs and authored private waveform slots.
temporaryClient.validation: Validate settings and sample identity/loop/private/host/PMON restrictions before mode writes; resolve all24 loops before NON/Clock writes.
temporaryClient.lifecycle: Clear binding on clearRam reset, end/new Code and dispose. Keep ownership fences, late keyup/stealing/source switch cleanup and exact authored-bank restoration.

Actual captured keyboard C2/C5 both use PITCH4096, NON0xffffff and Clock37, with finite nonzero PCM.
Noise Clock37/38 changes actual PCM; source PITCH0/0x3fff does not change fresh Noise PCM.
ADSR release reaches silence and the fixed support loop alone decodes to silence.
Temporary Noise supports null editor waveform slots, low/high MIDI, chords, cancellation and authored Noise restoration.
